A man lives on the twentieth floor. But every evening, he rides the lift only to floor ten.
Then he climbs the last ten floors. By foot. Every single day.
But when it rains, something changes.
Same man. Same lift. And this time, he rides it all the way to twenty.
The lift isn't broken. So why does he only reach the top when it rains? You have five seconds.
Look closer. He's very short. Floor ten is the highest button he can reach.
But on rainy days, he carries an umbrella.
One tap with the tip, and floor twenty lights up.
Did you get it? Follow for more.
